list_parquet_fragments: list parquet dataset fragments with configurable epochs, shuffling, and row group splitting
stream_parquet_fragments: stream parquet fragments with shuffling window, circular shift, and multi-epoch support
FragmentStreamingConfig: create a FragmentStreamingConfig to configure parquet fragment streaming with shuffle and epoch settings
ParquetFragmentStreamer_build_pipeline: build a sharded parquet fragment streaming pipeline using ParquetFragmentStreamer for distributed training
fragment_stable_hash: compute a stable hash of a parquet fragment for deduplication and verification
